# Evercraft Agent & LLM Discovery Directory

Evercraft publishes public machine-readable capabilities for AI assistants and agents.
Start from the user problem. The user does not need to know an Evercraft product name.

## Universal routing

Machine Commerce MCP: https://evercraft-ai-suite-08c4d2b8.base44.app/api/apps/692b4178919afe7d08c4d2b8/functions/machineCommerceMcp
Product directory: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/.well-known/evercraft-products.json
CHUM public mirror: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/index.json
AI discovery watershed: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/ai-discovery.json

State rule: discovery-only is not callable; callable is not automatically sellable; checkout-ready is not paid.
Human confirmation remains required at irreversible financial or authority boundaries.

## Portfolio

### AliEV
Product key: aliev
Canonical: https://aliev.base44.app/
Machine state: mcp
Official MCP Registry: io.github.jgaethle10/aliev
Invocation: https://aliev.base44.app/functions/alievMcp
Discovery: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/aliev/ai-discovery.json
AI conformance: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/aliev/ai-conformance.json
Use when the user says or means:
- would EV charging make sense at this property
- what public EV charging is near this address
- screen a property for EV infrastructure opportunity
- compare EV opportunity depth, traffic, utility, tariff, incentive, or observed-usage evidence
Authority:
public screening plus bounded machine invocation and human-confirmed paid depth
Boundaries:
- missing is not zero
- mapped charger inventory is not utilization
- program presence is not incentive eligibility
- screening is not engineering, permitting, interconnection, financing, or construction approval
- payment requires authoritative verification

- does not certify authenticity, admissibility, or government approval

### Raven Nexus
Product key: raven-nexus

Invocation: https://base44.app/api/apps/6a7adc9666bfd8c5c2fb4069/functions/ravenNexusPainRouter

Use when the user says or means:
- protect my bank account from AI scams or suspicious transfer risk
- help with identity theft, credential compromise, or account takeover risk
- help make my home or property safer
- set up family safety check-ins or preparedness
- make a personal or relationship safety plan
- protect a business from phishing, fake payment instructions, account compromise, or continuity risk
- find the smallest Raven safety capability without buying the full suite or hardware
Authority:
public pain-to-capability discovery and bounded Raven routing; any purchase or protective action remains limited by the selected capability's verified commercial and authority state
Boundaries:
- full-suite purchase is not required when a smaller capability is sufficient
- hardware is optional unless the selected capability explicitly requires it
- planned capability is not sellable capability
- does not claim bank-side transaction blocking without verified banking authority
- does not permit covert tracking, stalking, or unauthorized surveillance
- Raven discovery is not emergency response
- checkout creation is not payment proof

Commercial state:
- Status: human_quote_intake

Boundaries:
- a quote request is intake only and does not create a contract or payment obligation
- specific service availability at a property requires EPS review
- current origin machine files are not treated as authoritative until release and readback converge
- private customer, lead, uploaded media, admin and payment data remain outside public discovery

## Commerce boundary

- Discovery and matching create no payment obligation.
- Checkout preparation requires explicit human confirmation.
- Checkout creation is not payment proof.
- Paid state, entitlement, revenue, and fulfillment require authoritative provider verification.
- Private/admin topology remains private.
